pōtĭlis , e, adj. poto,
I.that pertains to drinking, drinking- (ante- and post-class.): potilis nidus, a drinking-vessel, Varr. ap. Non. 145, 4: “raptus,” a drawing in when drinking, sipping, Cael. Aur. Tard. 5, 10, 119 : “aërem recipere atque reddere haustu potili,” id. ib. 3, 8, 123 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
